corrections.source: A medium hoodie can have a chest marked 96 cm in one chart and 56 cm in another. Those figures may both be correct. Before purchasing through USFans, establish what each supplier measured, whose body or garment they measured, and how a familiar piece of clothing compares.
corrections.translation: 同样标为 M 码的连帽衫，一张尺码表可能写胸围 96 厘米，另一张却写 56 厘米，两种标法都可能成立。通过 USFans 购买前，先确认每家量的是什么部位，是人体尺寸还是成衣尺寸，再用自己熟悉的衣物按相同方法核对。

corrections.source: Measure any feature that would change your decision. A tall buyer may be able to tolerate an extra centimetre of width but need a very particular sleeve or body length. A cropped jacket may fit across the chest while exposing a shirt beneath it. Write down an acceptable interval based on garments you actually own, if you can. Someone happy with shirts measuring 52 to 55 cm flat has a more useful reference than someone who writes only “normally medium.” This interval describes your preference; it is not a manufacturing tolerance or a promise from the seller.
corrections.translation: 只要某个尺寸会改变购买决定，就值得量。个子高的人也许不在意衣服多宽一厘米，却很在意袖长或衣长；短外套即使胸围合适，也可能会露出里面的衬衫。条件允许时，用自己穿着合适的衣服量出能接受的范围。比起只写“平时穿 M”，写“平铺胸宽 52 至 55 厘米的衬衫都合适”更便于比较。这个范围是个人偏好，不是卖家的承诺，也不是生产公差。

corrections.source: Suppose your reference hoodie measures 56 cm flat across the chest. A chart listing a 112 cm finished chest circumference is consistent with that width for a simple, reasonably symmetrical garment laid flat. Dividing the circumference by two gives a 56 cm comparison point. If 112 cm instead describes the recommended wearer's chest, dividing by two does not tell you how wide the hoodie will be. Likewise, an entry of 56 cm described as a half chest can be compared directly to your flat measurement. These are examples to illustrate units, not a size recommendation.
corrections.translation: 假设参考连帽衫平铺后胸宽 56 厘米。对于结构简单、两边大致对称的衣服，成衣胸围 112 厘米通常与这个宽度相符；将成衣胸围除以二，就得到可比较的 56 厘米。但若 112 厘米指推荐穿着者的身体胸围，除以二并不能推出衣服本身有多宽。如果尺码表明确写的是半胸围 56 厘米，就可以直接和平铺胸宽比较。这些数字用来说明量法，并非尺码推荐。

corrections.source: If two versions share one chart and the photographs suggest different proportions, state the conflict precisely. Ask which version has the listed length and whether the dimension includes the collar. A question framed as “will medium fit me?” leaves the seller or agent guessing at your preferred fit. A question framed as “does the short black medium measure 63 cm from the back collar seam to the centre hem?” identifies the version, size, endpoints and number that drive your decision. Keep that conversation attached to the purchase reference in your records.
corrections.translation: 如果两个版本共用一张尺码表，照片上的比例却明显不同，就把矛盾说具体。问清标注的衣长对应哪个版本、测量时是否包含衣领。仅问“M 码适合我吗”，卖家或代购还得猜你的穿衣偏好。换成“黑色短款 M 码，从后领接缝到下摆正中是否为 63 厘米”，便明确了版本、尺码、起止点和影响决定的数字。保存回复时，注明对应的订单。

corrections.source: Keep a compact record with the seller listing, selected version, size, seller measurement method and reference measurement. Add the warehouse observation on a new line so that it stays distinct from the seller's claim. For example, write “chart gives 110 cm finished chest, my preferred hoodie is 54–56 cm flat, actual item photographed at 55 cm across underarms.” With that information the reason for keeping the size remains clear even after other packages arrive. If the methods do not match, record the question instead of manufacturing a precise comparison.
corrections.translation: 用一条简明记录保存商品链接、所选版本、尺码、卖家量法和自己的参考尺寸。仓库实际测量另起一行，以免和卖家标注混在一起。例如：“尺码表标注成衣胸围 110 厘米；自己穿着合适的连帽衫平铺胸宽为 54 至 56 厘米；收到的商品实拍显示两侧腋下之间为 55 厘米。”即使之后又收到其他包裹，也能看清当时保留这个尺码的理由。量法不同就记下疑问，不必硬算出一个貌似精确的差值。

corrections.source: Budget product price and domestic delivery together for the purchasing stage, while recording them separately. Keep later international freight as a different cost. Consider an example where an advertised item costs 70 yuan and the seller quotes 8 yuan domestic delivery for the order. Two units would give a product subtotal of 140 yuan; a single shared delivery charge would make 148 yuan before any separately listed amounts. If the 8 yuan applies per unit instead, the arithmetic changes. The example gives a checking method, not a USFans rate. Read the actual confirmation rather than copying the catalogue's lowest displayed price.
corrections.translation: 购买阶段做预算时，商品价和国内运费都要考虑，但应分开记录；后续国际运费再列一项。例如商品单价 70 元，卖家写明整笔订单的国内运费为 8 元。买两件时商品小计 140 元，只收一次运费的话，合计 148 元，尚未计入其他另列费用。如果每件都要收 8 元，结果就不同。这只是核算方法，不是 USFans 的收费标准。以订单实际确认为准，不要直接采用商品目录中显示的最低价。

corrections.source: Suppose a sample offer lists 2–9 units at 24 yuan and 10 or more at 20 yuan. Six units at the first rate cost 144 yuan. Ten at the second rate cost 200 yuan. The second rate is lower per unit, yet it requires a larger total payment and leaves four additional units to ship or store. These are illustrative figures. When deciding what to buy, compare total product cost at your intended quantity, then include any separately quoted domestic delivery. Treat the lower unit rate as valuable only if the extra pieces serve a purpose and the seller confirms the mix qualifies.
corrections.translation: 假设某商品 2 至 9 件每件 24 元，10 件起每件 20 元。按第一档买 6 件要 144 元；按第二档买 10 件要 200 元。后者单价虽低，总支出却更高，还多出 4 件要存放或寄送。这些只是示例数字。比较时先算自己需要的数量对应的商品总价，再加上另列的国内运费。只有多出来的商品确实有用，而且卖家确认所选规格可以合并满足该档条件，低单价才有实际意义。

corrections.source: Check the specification from the garment owner's perspective. Imagine a hypothetical print reading MARTÍN and 07. The accent is part of the name and the leading zero is part of the number. A seller might normalize the name to MARTIN or treat 07 as the number seven when entering it into another system. Ask the recipient to repeat the intended text in writing or supply a proof if that service is available. Keep any agreed substitute spelling in a separate message. Silence about an unsupported accent is different from the buyer explicitly accepting a version without it.
corrections.translation: 站在穿这件衣服的人的角度核对定制要求。假设图案应印 MARTÍN 和 07。重音符号是姓名的一部分，开头的零也是号码的一部分。卖家在另一个系统里录入时，可能会把 MARTÍN 改成 MARTIN，或将 07 当成数字七。请接单方用文字复述准确内容；如果提供效果图服务，也可以先核对效果图。双方认可的替代拼法应单独留条记录。对方没有回应重音符号是否可用，不等于买家同意去掉它。

corrections.source: If a difference remains, send the order reference, the approved proof and the photograph of the actual piece together. Describe the precise discrepancy, such as “the proof shows 07 and the finished back shows 7.” Ask which options are available under the order conditions. Preserve the packaging and tags until the response clarifies what the seller needs. For a group order, identify only the affected units and continue tracking the rest separately. This yields a clear record of what was requested, what was accepted and what actually arrived, which is much more useful than a general complaint that the design looks wrong.
corrections.translation: 若差异仍然存在，把订单编号、已确认的效果图和实物照片一并发给对方。具体说明哪里不同，例如“效果图是 07，成衣背面却是 7”。再询问按照该订单的条件可以怎样处理。在卖家说明需要什么之前，保留包装和吊牌。团体订单只标出受影响的件数，其余商品继续分别跟踪。这样能清楚还原当初要求了什么、确认了什么、实际收到了什么，比只说设计看起来不对更有用。

corrections.source: Choose the exact variants first, then calculate the cost of obtaining the intended outfit. In an illustrative offer, a jacket at 85 yuan and trousers at 60 yuan make a product subtotal of 145 yuan, while a complete set is offered at 135 yuan. The set costs less only if it contains both pieces in suitable sizes. Include any domestic shipping charge according to the seller's actual checkout. One delivery charge shared by two selections behaves differently from delivery quoted per separately purchased piece. Keep the source currency visible when comparing.
corrections.translation: 先选定所需的具体规格，再核算凑齐这套衣服要花多少钱。举例说，一件外套 85 元、一条裤子 60 元，分开购买商品小计为 145 元；整套售价为 135 元。只有套装确实同时包含这两件商品、尺码也都合适，才算更便宜。国内运费以卖家的实际结算页面为准：两件共收一次，与每件单独收取，不能混为一谈。比较时也要保留卖家使用的原币种。

corrections.source: A third piece pictured alongside the set can change the calculation. If a matching belt is important, check whether either offer actually includes it. If the belt costs a further 12 yuan and is excluded from both offers, add it to both totals. If just one offer includes it, note that the offers now have different contents. Do the same for removable straps, hoods or liners when they are essential. Avoid turning a set comparison into a comparison of two unrelated totals simply because the thumbnail photographs happen to look alike.
corrections.translation: 图片里多出现的一件配件可能改变总价比较。比如你需要配套腰带，先看两种报价中是否有包含腰带的。如果腰带另售 12 元，且两种报价都不含腰带，两个总价都应加上这 12 元。如果只有一个报价包含腰带，应注明两边的内容已经不同。对于必需的可拆卸带子、帽子或内衬，也可这样处理。缩略图相似，并不代表两个总价覆盖的是同一套东西。

corrections.source: Put the two photographs side by side. Imagine your reference insert measures 27.2 cm and the new photographed insert appears to measure 27.4 cm using a comparable method. The visible difference is about 2 mm. A slightly curved insert, a different camera angle or an imprecise ruler position can account for small differences. Avoid turning a rough photo comparison into an exact fit guarantee. By contrast, a clear multi-centimetre difference with matching methods would justify checking the size label and asking whether the photographed pair is the intended option.
corrections.translation: 把两张照片并排看。假设自己穿着合适的鞋垫长 27.2 厘米，仓库用相近方法拍到的新鞋垫约为 27.4 厘米，可见差约为 2 毫米。鞋垫略微弯曲、相机角度不同或尺子摆放不准，都可能造成小差异。不能把照片上的粗略比较当成合脚保证。反过来，如果量法一致却明显相差几厘米，就值得核对尺码标签，并问清拍到的是不是原先所选的那双鞋。

corrections.source: Give each intended unit or group a short label that stays stable throughout the process. For instance, label a navy jacket J1 and the two matching trousers T1 and T2. Use warehouse and parcel identifiers alongside these labels as they become available. Do not replace the labels with successive tracking numbers. Identifiers from different stages often have different scopes: one buyer order can cover several seller deliveries, and one outbound parcel can cover several buyer orders. A stable per-item reference lets you connect all these records without assuming they share the same numbering system.
corrections.translation: 给每件或每组准备寄出的商品设一个简短、固定的编号。例如，藏青色外套记作 J1，两条配套裤子分别记作 T1 和 T2。拿到仓库编号和包裹编号后，把它们补在旁边，不要用不断变化的物流单号替代固定商品编号。不同阶段的编号覆盖范围不一样：一笔购买订单可能由卖家分几次送达，一个出境包裹也可能合并多笔订单。保留逐件编号，就能串起这些记录，而不必假设它们用的是同一套编号体系。

corrections.source: The option menu says grey, the picture looks green and the seller's colour code ends in G2. Which of these describes the item you will actually receive? Work from the seller's option identity, then use photographs to answer the remaining questions about appearance.
corrections.translation: 规格菜单写“灰色”，图片看着偏绿，卖家的颜色代码又以 G2 结尾。哪一项能说明最终发来的商品？先确认卖家系统里对应的是哪个选项，再用实拍图判断仍不确定的外观细节。

corrections.source: For a two-colour purchase, an illustrative note could read “one G2 grey-green medium with dark zip, and one C1 cream medium with cream zip.” Ask before accepting a substitution if the intended colour is unavailable. Someone filling the order may read two similar translations and treat a nearby option as interchangeable, while the buyer needs a matching piece for an existing outfit. Giving both the code and feature reduces this risk without claiming a colour standard that the seller never promised. Save the confirmation beside the selected-state screenshot.
corrections.translation: 购买两种颜色时，可以这样写备注：“G2 灰绿色，中码，深色拉链，1 件；C1 奶油色，中码，奶油色拉链，1 件。”所选颜色缺货时，先确认再接受替代。处理订单的人可能因为两个颜色译名接近，认为可以互换，而买家可能需要与现有服装精确搭配。把代码和特征一起写上，能减少误会，也不会把卖家没承诺过的色彩标准强加给对方。把确认记录和选中规格的截图放在一起保存。

corrections.source: Start at the top of the chart, including any diagram above it. A seller may give recommended body measurements, measurements of the finished garment, or a weight-and-height suggestion. Reading one number without that context can send you to a different size. A recommended chest circumference describes the wearer. A finished chest circumference describes the garment. The latter usually includes space between fabric and body; the amount varies with cut, stretch and intended fit. Two shirts intended for the same wearer can therefore have very different finished measurements.
corrections.translation: 先看尺码表上方的标题和示意图。卖家列的可能是建议人体尺寸、成衣实测尺寸，也可能只是按身高体重给出的建议。建议胸围指穿衣人的身体，成衣胸围则量的是衣服，通常含衣料与身体之间的余量。余量随剪裁、弹性和设计版型而变。因此，为同一身材设计的两件衬衫，成衣尺寸可以差很多。

corrections.source: A diagram adds information that a translated column heading can lose. An arrow running horizontally across the front of a garment suggests a flat width. A loop around a model's torso suggests circumference. An arrow from shoulder to hem might indicate length, but its starting point matters. If the chart only shows a size letter and a number, keep the ambiguity visible in your notes. The product picture can suggest how a garment is supposed to look; it cannot tell you which interpretation the seller used for the chart. Ask for the method before committing to a marginal size.
corrections.translation: 看示意图能补足翻译表头丢掉的信息。横跨衣服正面的箭头通常表示平铺宽度，绕模特一圈的线通常表示围度。从肩到下摆的箭头可能是衣长，但还要看从哪里起量。如果表里只有尺码字母和一个数字，就把这个疑问记下来。商品图可以说明想呈现的版型，不能说明卖家采用哪种量法。介于两码之间时，先问量法再决定。

corrections.source: Pick a piece that fits the way you want this purchase to fit. For a winter overshirt, use one that goes comfortably over the layer you expect to wear underneath it. Comparing against a fitted T-shirt would answer a different question. Close buttons or zips, lay the garment on a flat surface and let it settle. Straighten obvious folds without pulling the fabric taut. Measure between the underarm seams across the front and record the distance, units and orientation. A photograph of your tape placement can be more valuable than a list of numbers alone.
corrections.translation: 找一件穿着效果最接近目标的衣服作参照。比如想买冬季衬衫式外套，就选择一件套在预期内搭外面仍舒服的外套；拿修身 T 恤比较回答不了同一个问题。扣好钮扣或拉好拉链，平铺衣服，抚平明显褶皱，不要拉紧布料。沿正面量两侧腋下接缝之间的直线距离，记下数值、单位和方向。顺手拍下软尺的位置，往往比只存数字更便于复核。

corrections.source: Length requires a different check. A back measured from the seam at the base of the collar to the middle hem often has a different result from a line beginning at the highest point near the shoulder. Repeat the seller's stated method on your reference garment before comparing. A dropped shoulder complicates sleeve measurements: the sleeve seam begins lower on the arm, so the sleeve alone can measure shorter while the cuff still reaches the same point. If the chart measures from the centre back of the neck instead, include that distance on your reference piece too.
corrections.translation: 衣长另有讲究。从领根接缝量到后摆中央，和从靠近肩部的最高点起量，结果往往不同。先按卖家说的量法测自己的参照衣。落肩款的袖缝起点更靠下，因此即使袖子本身短些，袖口也可能到同一个位置。若卖家从后颈正中起量袖长，测参照衣时也要把那一段算进去。

corrections.source: A single listing can put standard, oversized and cropped versions next to each other. Check whether the chart changes when you select the version you want. Inspect the wording above the diagram and look for model numbers shared with the option buttons. An excellent chart for the standard version can produce a poor decision on the cropped version. Save the selected option wording in its original form, a short description in your own words and the chart that applies to it. Keep the product link beside those records so you can revisit the same offer.
corrections.translation: 一个商品页可能同时卖标准版、宽松版和短款。切换到想买的版本，看尺码表是否随之变化；核对示意图上方的文字和选项按钮上的型号。标准版的数据再详细，也未必适用于短款。保留所选规格的原文、自己的简短说明及适用的尺码表，把商品链接放在旁边，方便日后回到同一件商品。

corrections.source: The USFans beginner's guide describes warehouse inspection and the photographs available after receipt. Check the photographs attached to your specific warehouse entry. A clear label can establish what size is printed on that piece. It cannot establish how wide it is when laid flat. If a few centimetres will affect whether you keep it, ask through the order channel whether the measurement you need can be obtained, what it would cost if it is an additional service, and whether there is enough time to review it before the next decision.
corrections.translation: USFans 新手指南介绍了入库验货和收货后可查看的照片。请打开与自己入库记录对应的图片。清楚的标签只能证明这件衣服标了什么尺码，不能证明实际平铺宽度。如果几厘米就会改变去留，通过订单渠道询问能否按需要测量、额外服务是否收费，以及能否在下一步操作前留出核对时间。

corrections.source: For a useful photograph, request the garment flat with both endpoints visible. Tell the person handling it exactly where to place the tape. Look for the zero mark, correct units and alignment with the seams. If the start disappears beneath a fold, explain which view is missing. A close-up of the final reading might make the number easy to read while making the position impossible to check. Review shape as well as size: a curved hem, wide shoulder and elasticated waistband can change how two garments with the same recorded chest measurement sit on the body.
corrections.translation: 请仓库把衣服平铺，并在同一张照片里拍到软尺两端。说明从哪里量到哪里，检查零点、单位和接缝对齐情况。如果起点藏在褶皱下面，就指出缺少哪个角度。只拍末端刻度虽然能读数，却无法核对摆尺位置。也要考虑剪裁：弧形下摆、宽肩或松紧腰都会改变上身效果，即使两件衣服量出的胸宽相同。

corrections.source: When a piece falls close to the edge of your acceptable range, consider the practical consequence. A slightly roomy overshirt may still layer comfortably. A closely fitted non-stretch shirt with the same difference might be difficult to fasten. A shorter length may be part of the cut you wanted. Use the measured feature together with the intended use, then check the available options on your current USFans order if you need a clarification or change. This makes the final choice traceable to the garment you want and the evidence for the particular unit you are buying.
corrections.translation: 实测值接近可接受范围的边缘时，想想差异会造成什么后果。宽松一点的衬衫外套仍能叠穿，贴身又无弹性的衬衫差同样的尺寸却可能扣不上。衣长偏短也可能本来就是想要的剪裁。结合用途判断；如需追问或更改，到当前 USFans 订单查看可用选项。最后的决定就能追溯到这件实物和你实际想穿出的效果。

corrections.source: For knitwear, note whether the garment was relaxed when measured. Two flat widths taken with different tension are difficult to compare, even when the tape placement matches. If the garment will be layered, try your reference piece over that layer before recording the acceptable range. This catches a surprisingly common oversight: measuring a sweatshirt that is comfortable over a T-shirt and using that result to choose a coat intended to fit over the sweatshirt itself.
corrections.translation: 测针织衣物时记下布料是否处于自然放松状态。即使软尺位置相同，用力不同也会让两次胸宽难以比较。如果准备叠穿，先套上预计会穿的内搭，再试参照衣并记录可接受的范围。卫衣套 T 恤正好，并不能证明按这件卫衣的宽度挑选的大衣还容得下卫衣本身。

corrections.source: An empty product page leaves two questions open. The marketplace listing might still exist, and the agent might still be able to purchase the exact option. Establish each fact separately before paying or accepting a similar product.
corrections.translation: 商品页面空白时，还有两件事需要分别核实。原平台上的商品可能仍在出售，而代购平台也可能仍能买到你要的具体规格。付款或接受替代商品前，把这两点逐项确认。

corrections.source: Begin by returning to the page where the link came from. A spreadsheet row might point to an agent, a seller listing, a shop collection, or an image album. These destinations contain different information. A purchase request needs an identifiable item and a seller who can supply it. An album may show a jacket from six angles while providing neither a price nor an orderable option. Follow the seller link supplied with the entry when there is one. Record which page opens successfully and which page fails. “The marketplace page opens but the agent page shows no options” is a useful diagnosis.
corrections.translation: 先回到最初找到链接的页面。表格中的一行可能通向代购页、卖家商品页、店铺合集或相册。代购请求需要能识别的商品，还要有能供货的卖家。相册可能有六个角度的外套照片，却没有价格或可下单规格。若条目附有卖家链接就打开，并记录哪个页面正常、哪个失败。比如“原平台的商品页能打开，代购页没有规格按钮”，这就便于定位问题。

corrections.source: If a link came from a messaging app, check whether the pasted text includes a sentence, a product title or punctuation alongside the address. Retain the original message, then copy just the link intended for the item. Open it normally and compare the displayed seller and item with the saved find. A redirect to a shop homepage means you still need the individual product page. A removed listing is a separate problem: an agent cannot derive current stock merely from an old picture. Capture the page state and date so the person helping you can distinguish an import problem from an unavailable offer.
corrections.translation: 如果链接来自聊天软件，检查复制的文字是否还包含商品标题、句子或标点。保留原消息，再只复制其中的商品网址，正常打开后核对店铺和商品。如果跳到店铺首页，还要找到单品页。商品下架是另一种情况，代购无法凭旧图确认当前库存。保存页面当时的状态和日期，方便对方区分链接导入失败还是商品已无法购买。

corrections.source: Write down the source marketplace, seller name, product title and item identifier where visible. Use the same marketplace when comparing identifiers. A number from a warehouse record refers to a different system from a number in a Weidian product URL. A copied product name alone is weak evidence because sellers can reuse it across different pieces. Look for a model reference, a distinguishing construction detail, and original option wording. In a full product family, the item number can remain the same for both the standard coat and a shorter version.
corrections.translation: 记下平台、店铺名称、商品标题和能看到的商品编号。不同系统的编号不能混用：仓库记录号和微店商品网址中的编号并非一回事。单靠标题也容易认错，多个商品可以用同名。进一步核对型号、独特的结构细节和规格原文。一个商品系列中的标准外套与短款可能共用同一个商品编号。

corrections.source: Photographs can help locate the seller, but keep discovery and confirmation separate. USFans describes product-link, keyword and photo searches in its beginner's guide. Use a name search when the original title contains distinctive words, and a picture search when the available image clearly shows the model. If several shops reuse the same catalogue image, keep more than one candidate until you can inspect their option lists. A candidate without the requested size or model is not an equivalent purchase, even if an image-search result puts it first. Note any difference that would change the amount you pay or the garment you receive.
corrections.translation: 照片可用于找卖家，找到候选商品后仍要核实。USFans 新手指南介绍了商品链接、关键词和图片搜索。标题有独特用词时可先搜文字，图片能清楚看出款式时可搜图。多家店沿用同一组目录图很常见，先保留几个候选，逐一检查规格。即使排在搜图结果第一，缺少所需尺码或型号也不是同等选择。记下会影响价格或到手实物的任何差别。

corrections.source: Once the original item is identified, make a short order note. Include the seller URL, the original text of the required option, size, colour, quantity and any indispensable feature. Avoid relying on position in a menu: the third blue swatch on a desktop screen may not occupy the same position after a listing changes or on a smaller display. If option labels are ambiguous, attach the selected-state screenshot and explain what the label means in context. Name the component you want when a listing sells individual pieces and sets from the same page.
corrections.translation: 找到原商品后，写明卖家网址、所需规格原文、尺码、颜色、数量和不可缺少的特征。不要写“第三个蓝色”：换设备或卖家调整菜单后，顺序就可能变。规格名称含糊时，附上已选中状态的截图，解释它在这个商品页上指什么。若同一页既卖单件又卖套装，直接写要哪一件。

corrections.source: An illustrative order note might read: “Please check availability of two navy overshirts, model B with the straight hem, both size L. The seller calls the option Navy B. I need the shirts only. Please ask before changing model, colour or size.” That note answers a question about quantity and places a clear limit on substitution. If you would accept an alternative, state the exact alternative and any condition, such as a maximum unit price. A later conversation about an unavailable option is much shorter when it begins with a written record of what the buyer already approved.
corrections.translation: 一条备注可以这样写：“请确认两件藏青色衬衫外套是否有货，都是直下摆的 B 款、L 码。卖家的规格名是 Navy B。只需要衬衫，换款、换色或换码前请先询问。”这样既说明数量，也限定了可接受的变更。如果允许替代，写清替代型号以及单价上限等条件。规格缺货时，有这份记录就不必重新确认已经同意过的事项。

corrections.source: Ask through the current USFans order channel whether the listing and option can be purchased in this situation. Use the options actually displayed in the account. A manual or assisted purchase is an inquiry until the agent has identified what can be ordered and at what price. Changing marketplace stock, seller restrictions or a minimum order can affect the outcome. Check the unit, number of units and currency on the confirmation. If the item is sold by the pair, for example, a quantity of two could mean two pairs. Quote the unit back before approving a substantial order.
corrections.translation: 通过当前 USFans 订单里实际显示的渠道询问能否购买该商品及具体规格。平台还没确认可以买什么、多少钱时，人工代购仍只是询问。库存、卖家限制或起订量都可能改变结果。核对确认单上的计价单位、数量和币种。比如按双卖的商品，数量二可能是两双。大额订单获准付款前，把单位复述一遍。

corrections.source: Sometimes the response resolves one question and leaves another open. “Available” might refer to the model but not the size, or “same price” might refer to the product before domestic delivery. Reply with the unresolved question and quote the relevant line from your order note. Avoid sending a fresh set of pictures without identifying which one is the selected version. If the seller proposes a substitute, ask for its own listing, distinguishing features, price and size information. Save the proposal as a new option so it does not overwrite the details of the original request.
corrections.translation: “有货”可能只说这一款，没有确认尺码；“同价”可能只说商品价，没有算上国内运费。引用备注中相应的一行，只追问还不清楚的部分。不要一次发一批图片，却不说明选中的是哪款。如果卖家推替代品，另要它的链接、区别、价格和尺码资料，并把它作为新选项保存，别覆盖原来的要求。

corrections.source: Use the purchase decision to control risk. When the image, option text and unit agree, you can decide whether the offer meets your needs. When the seller can only promise “something similar,” decide whether the uncertainty is acceptable for this specific purchase. For an item personalized with a name, an ambiguous order note can lead to a difficult disagreement. For a standard item you may simply prefer to wait for an identifiable listing. Check applicable cancellation and after-sales terms on the current order before authorizing work that changes the product. Record a decision to decline as clearly as a decision to proceed.
corrections.translation: 图片、规格文字和销售单位一致后，再判断是否合适。如果卖家只能保证“差不多”，要看这次购买能否接受这种不确定性。定制姓名的商品尤其容易因备注不清产生争议；普通货品则可以等到能确认的商品页再买。授权改动商品前，核对当前订单适用的取消及售后条件。决定拒绝时，也要像同意购买时那样留下一条明确记录。

corrections.source: After purchase, link the seller reference to the USFans order number and any later warehouse reference. Keep those as separate fields. When warehouse photos become available, return to the manual specification and check the few details that distinguished this purchase in the first place. For the overshirt example, look for two units, the straight hem, the correct option label and the requested size. A photo of a folded navy shirt can be consistent with several different models. Ask for the missing view if one of your original conditions cannot be verified from the supplied pictures.
corrections.translation: 购买后，将卖家商品信息、USFans 订单号及后续仓库编号关联起来，但各自单独保存。仓库照片出来后，按原始代购要求检查关键区别。以前面的衬衫外套为例，应看到两件、直下摆、对应规格标签和所需尺码。一张叠起来的藏青色衬衫照片可能符合多款商品；若无法核实某项要求，就追问缺少的角度。

corrections.source: If the order eventually succeeds, save the corrected seller link and date alongside the original failed link. The next person reviewing your record can then tell which address imported correctly, which details required a manual conversation and what the warehouse actually received. If the seller withdraws the listing instead, retain the final response and close the inquiry without treating it as an order. That distinction matters when reconciling payments or counting pieces for an outbound parcel. A manual purchase works best when the final record is as precise as a normal product checkout, even though the information came from several separate screens.
corrections.translation: 如果买到商品，把修正后的卖家网址和日期与原失效链接一起存档。之后复核的人就能区分哪个网址成功导入、哪些细节靠人工沟通，以及仓库实际收到什么。若卖家撤下商品，保留最终答复并结束询问，不要把它当作订单。这样核对付款或统计待出库件数时不会重复计算。人工购买的资料虽来自不同页面，最终记录仍应像普通结账单那样清楚。

corrections.source: A wholesale listing can look affordable until the buyer discovers that the displayed unit is a pack, that the minimum applies to each colour, or that the price shown belongs to a quantity they do not intend to buy. Resolve those details together before submitting a USFans order.
corrections.translation: 批发页上的报价初看很低，点进规格才发现报价按整包计算、每种颜色要分别达到起订量，或低价只适用于自己根本买不到的数量。在 USFans 提交订单前，把销售单位、起订规则和价格档位放在一起核实。

corrections.source: Start with the live marketplace offer. Note the seller, listing identifier and date, then read the unit printed next to the price or quantity selector. A page selling socks may use a pair, a pack of pairs or a full assortment as the orderable unit. Attractive photographs of six colours do not establish whether the buyer receives six pairs. Check the text attached to the selected option, the package contents and the order summary. If these disagree, ask which rule applies to the specific option. Keep the response with the order rather than relying on a remembered interpretation of the listing.
corrections.translation: 打开当前的原平台商品页，记下卖家、商品编号和日期，查看价格或数量框旁边的单位。卖袜子时，单位可能是一双、一包多双或一整组配色。照片放了六种颜色，不能证明下单会收到六双。核对已选规格、包装内容和订单摘要；三者不一致，就询问该规格实际按什么规则供货，将答复随订单保存。

corrections.source: Write the desired purchase in ordinary language before touching the selector. For example, “I need three individual navy pairs and three grey pairs, all the same size.” Translate that into the seller's units only after the unit is known. If the unit is a pack of three identical pairs, the request could be two units. If it is an assorted pack containing several fixed colours, two units may produce a completely different mix. An item title saying “six colours available” describes a choice and says nothing about the contents of one pack. This check takes less time than untangling an unwanted assortment at the warehouse.
corrections.translation: 调整数量前，先用自己的话写出需求，例如“藏青色三双，灰色三双，均为同一码”。单位明确后再换算：如果每包含三双同色袜子，或许需要下两包；若每包是固定混色，两包的配色可能完全不同。“六色可选”只说明有六个选项，不等于一包有六色。提前核实比货到仓库后再拆分不要的配色更省事。

corrections.source: A minimum order tells you whether the seller will accept a purchase at all. A price tier tells you the unit rate applicable at a particular quantity. They can appear close together on the screen, but they answer different questions. A seller might accept two units at one price and offer a lower rate starting at ten. Selecting two would satisfy the minimum while leaving the cheaper tier out of reach. On a listing offering multiple sizes, check whether the minimum applies to the entire item, each option, a specific combination or a full style run.
corrections.translation: 起订量回答的是“卖家接不接单”；阶梯单价回答的是“买到这个数量时每件多少钱”。卖家可能两件起订、十件起才有更低价，买两件只是满足下单要求。多规格商品还要确认起订量是按整款、每个选项、某个组合，还是整组尺码计算。

corrections.source: A mixed order can mean different things to different sellers. One seller may combine colours within one model and size. Another may allow different sizes of a single colour. A third may sell a preset assortment without allowing the buyer to choose the mix. Write down the distribution you want as separate lines and ask whether those lines can count toward the same minimum. If the listing already describes the rule, save the relevant wording. Use the original option codes beside your translated descriptions, especially where adjacent colours have nearly identical names.
corrections.translation: 不同卖家对“混批”的定义不同。有的限同一型号、尺码可以混色，有的限同色可以混码，也有的只出售预设组合。把想要的数量按规格逐行写出，询问这些行能否合计达到同一起订量。如果商品页已写明规则，保存原文。在自己翻译的颜色名旁附上卖家规格代码，特别是两个近似色的名字本就相近时。

corrections.source: Take a second example. You need four blue medium pieces, two blue large pieces and four green medium pieces. That makes ten units in total. If a ten-unit tier applies across the listing, your mix may qualify. If ten units are required per colour, neither the six blue nor the four green qualify independently. If the seller counts each size-colour combination separately, there are three groups. The arithmetic is simple once the grouping rule is known. Until then, the total on a spreadsheet row is only a planning figure. Ask for confirmation of both the mix and the price before treating the order as approved.
corrections.translation: 再举一例：蓝色 M 码四件、蓝色 L 码两件、绿色 M 码四件，共十件。若整款合计十件就能享受阶梯价，这个组合可能符合；若每种颜色都要十件，蓝色六件和绿色四件分别均未达标；若按颜色与尺码的组合计算，则是三个组。规则确定前，表格上的十件只是计划数量。确认配比和报价后，再把订单标为已核准。

corrections.source: USFans describes selecting product options and quantities after loading a marketplace link. Check the imported selections against the 1688 offer you just examined. If a tier table or package description did not import clearly, keep the seller page and ask about the unresolved detail through the order channel. Enter a separate selection for each combination when the interface permits it. In the remarks, describe how many physical pieces you expect from each line. This makes a pack-based purchase intelligible to someone who sees only the order units later.
corrections.translation: USFans 指南介绍了导入平台链接后选择规格和数量的步骤。把导入结果与刚核对的 1688 报价逐项比较。若阶梯表或包装说明未完整导入，保留卖家页面，在订单渠道追问。界面允许时，每种组合分别选择，并在备注中说明每行预期收到的实际件数。这样后面只看到订单数量的人也能看懂按包购买的商品。

corrections.source: Keep a simple reconciliation record with four columns: seller option, order units, pieces per unit and expected physical pieces. Three packs of two make six pieces; three single pieces make three. Include the size on each line even when a single size appears throughout the order. A later stock message may propose a substitution on only one colour. Check whether the change also affects the total price tier or minimum. An offer meeting the threshold before one unavailable line is removed might no longer do so afterwards. Request the revised subtotal and any change to domestic delivery in the same conversation.
corrections.translation: 做一张四列对照表：卖家规格、下单单位数、每单位实物件数、预期总件数。三包每包两件是六件，单件买三份只有三件。即使整单尺码相同也逐行标注。若某一颜色缺货需要替换或删去，还要确认原先满足的阶梯价或起订量是否仍有效，并在同一轮沟通里确认新小计与国内运费。

corrections.source: USFans notes that products purchased from 1688 can follow different inspection standards. Read the inspection terms that apply to the actual order. Before buying, decide what evidence you need for the quantity and option mix. A single outer carton marked with a model number can help identify the shipment without proving how many pieces are inside or how the colours are distributed. If opening a sealed retail pack matters to a future return, check the conditions before requesting it. A photo request should specify whether you need a count of packages, loose units, labels or all three.
corrections.translation: USFans 提醒，1688 采购商品适用的验货标准可能不同，具体以本单条款为准。下单前考虑如何证明数量与规格配比。外箱的型号标记能帮助识别发来的货，不足以证明箱内件数和各色数量。如果拆开密封零售包装可能影响退货，先核对条件再要求开封。申请拍照时说明要数外包装、散件，还是要同时看标签。

corrections.source: Suppose the warehouse photographs four sealed bags containing three pairs each. If your order was for twelve pairs in four identical packs, this can support an outer-pack count. If it was for six navy and six grey pairs, a photograph showing only the outer carton leaves the colour split unresolved. Ask for readable package labels first. If labels distinguish colours but not sizes, name the remaining question rather than asking for the whole inspection to be repeated. Keep any seller packing list in context: it records the seller's stated contents and can guide inspection, while pictures of the received items provide separate evidence.
corrections.translation: 假设仓库拍到四袋密封袜子，每袋标三双。若订的是四包同款、共十二双，这张图支持“外包装有四袋”的判断。若要求藏青色六双、灰色六双，只见外箱的照片无法核实配色。先要能读清的包装标签；标签能区分颜色但看不出尺码，就只追问尺码。卖家的装箱单记录其声称装了什么，可作验货线索，和仓库对入库实物的照片是两项不同的证据。

corrections.source: If ten units were ordered and eight appear in the first warehouse entry, look for a second domestic shipment before assuming a shortage. Compare seller tracking numbers with the agent order and warehouse entries. Then send a concise account of the expected and observed quantities. Identify which combinations are missing. “Two units short” is less actionable than “both green large units are absent; six blue and two green medium units are present.” Ask whether a second package is pending, whether another option was supplied, or whether the seller needs to address a short shipment.
corrections.translation: 订了十件，第一条入库记录只见八件，先查是否有第二个国内包裹。将卖家提供的单号对应到代购订单及入库记录，再简述预期与实收。写明缺哪个规格，例如“绿色 L 码两件均未见；已见蓝色六件和绿色 M 码两件”。这样比只说“少两件”更容易核实究竟是分包未到、规格发错，还是卖家少发。

corrections.source: Finalize the order record only when the seller mix, amounts paid and warehouse count agree or when the remaining difference has a documented resolution. If a partial refund is offered, record the units it covers and the currency and destination of the refund. If the seller resends missing pieces, wait for their own tracking reference and inspect the replacement mix. Finally, select only the warehouse entries you actually intend to forward. This closes the loop between the wholesale quantity shown on the listing and the physical pieces that will occupy your international parcel.
corrections.translation: 卖家的配比、付款金额和仓库数量吻合，或余下差异已有可查的处理结果，才完成订单核对。若部分退款，记清对应几件、币种和退款去向；若卖家补寄，等新的国内单号并核验补到的规格。最后只选择确实准备转运的入库记录，让批发页上的下单数量和最终装进国际包裹的实物一一对应。

corrections.source: An image search can recover a useful lead when all you have is a saved photograph. Turning that lead into an identifiable seller listing takes a second kind of work. The result must match the features that matter, open to an available option, and carry enough information for you to tell another buyer exactly what you found.
corrections.translation: 只剩一张收藏的照片时，以图搜货能提供线索。要落实到可买的商品，还需确认结果对得上关键特征、链接内有可选规格，并且留下足够信息，让别人也能说清你到底找到了什么。

corrections.source: A saved outfit photograph can contain shoes, trousers, a jacket and a bag. Start by naming the object and the detail that made you save the picture. Perhaps it was the shape of a side pocket on the jacket or the way a strap attaches to the bag. Create a crop that isolates the object while preserving its outline. Leave the relevant feature in the frame. A tight crop around a graphic can make the search engine return another garment carrying the same graphic, and a full outfit image can make the trousers dominate a search intended for the jacket.
corrections.translation: 穿搭图里可能同时有鞋、裤子、外套和包。先写明想找哪一件、最吸引你的是外套侧袋形状还是包带的连接方式。裁图时保留整件轮廓与关键细节；只裁印花容易搜到同图案的别款衣服，整套穿搭都保留又可能让裤子盖过目标外套。

corrections.source: Keep an untouched copy of the source picture. Use copies to experiment with a wider crop and a close detail. If the item appears in several views, save them together instead of assuming the most attractive view will be the most informative. A front view might be enough to find a product family, while the back view separates two versions. Remove visible usernames, addresses or parcel labels from anything you upload. For this task the useful evidence is the product itself. A buyer's shipping label adds no value to a visual search and exposes information unrelated to identifying the item.
corrections.translation: 留一份未经处理的原图，再用副本尝试全景和细节裁切。有正面、背面等多张照片就一起保存。正面或许足以找到系列，背面才看得出两个版本的区别。上传前遮住用户名、地址和快递面单。搜货需要的是商品本身，别人的收件标签既无助于识别，也会泄露无关信息。

corrections.source: The USFans beginner's guide describes finding products by marketplace link, keyword and uploaded image. If the original URL is missing, begin with the image route. Save a small set of promising results and note why each looks relevant. Run a keyword search after you have gathered labels, model names or original seller terminology from those results. That second search can locate an offer whose main photograph looks different but whose construction is a closer match. Multiple search routes answer the same question with different evidence.
corrections.translation: USFans 新手指南列出了商品链接、关键词和图片三种检索方式。没有原链接时先搜图，保留少量有希望的结果，分别记下匹配理由。再拿这些结果中的标签、型号或卖家原词搜文字，或许能找到主图不同、结构却更接近的商品。这两条路径给同一判断提供不同的线索。

corrections.source: On an independent USFans spreadsheet, image results are limited by what its catalogue contains and how its search matches images. The first result is a candidate rather than proof of origin. If nothing looks close, use a second crop or another angle. When every result shows the same large print on completely different garments, switch from a print crop to a whole-item image. When the silhouettes match but the wrong pocket or sole keeps appearing, bring that detail into a tighter crop. Change one aspect of the query at a time so you can see which change led to a better candidate.
corrections.translation: 独立的 USFans 商品表格只能从其已收录商品中匹配图片。排在第一只说明它是候选。没有接近的结果时，换裁切范围或角度；若全是同印花的不同衣服，改用整件图；若轮廓接近却总是口袋或鞋底不对，就放大该细节。每次只改一个条件，才知道哪一步让结果变好。

corrections.source: Open each candidate and compare the features the original image actually shows. With a jacket, check the number and angle of external pockets, hood attachment, cuff adjustment and seam placement. With a bag, inspect the strap attachment, hardware layout and how the opening closes. Compare left and right in relation to the item rather than the screen; a mirrored social photo can reverse the image. Colour is a weak first filter when lighting or editing differs. A pocket in a completely different position is usually more informative for identification than a small change in shade.
corrections.translation: 逐一打开候选，只对比原图确实可见的特征。外套可看外袋数量和角度、帽子连接处、袖口调节件及缝线；包可看肩带怎么连接、五金位置和包口怎么关闭。左右以物品本身为准，社交照片可能经过镜像。光线和后期处理会影响颜色，用来初筛时，一个明显错位的口袋通常比微小色差更有判断价值。

corrections.source: Keep a simple shortlist. A line such as “same pocket geometry, wrong ribbed cuff” is more helpful than a star rating without a reason. If all distinguishing details are hidden, leave the candidate unresolved. Seek another view instead of adding confidence because the overall styling looks familiar. A seller photograph reused by several shops establishes that the image circulates, not that each shop supplies the same item. Distinguish a listing that uses the exact photograph from a listing that offers visible evidence of the construction you actually want.
corrections.translation: 候选表里写“口袋轮廓相同，但袖口罗纹不对”，比只打星更实用。如果关键细节全被挡住，就保留疑问，寻找其他角度。多家店复用同一张图，能证明图片流传很广，不能证明每家供货相同。“用了原图”和“有证据证明是需要的结构”是两种不同的发现。

corrections.source: Once a candidate looks plausible, open the linked marketplace offer and record the marketplace, seller and item identifier. Different agent URLs can lead to the same seller item, while two marketplace listings can use indistinguishable promotional images. Inspect the option menu on the live offer. Does it include the colour and version you want? Does selecting the option change the picture or product description? If the product family has multiple versions, save the exact selected wording. A link that opens the right family on a default variant can still produce an incorrect purchase.
corrections.translation: 找到形似的商品后，打开真实销售页，记录平台、店铺和商品编号。不同代购链接可能通向同一件货，也有不同商品共用几乎一样的宣传图。看看当前能否选中所需颜色和版本，选中后图片或说明是否改变。若有多个版本，保存规格原文。链接即使打开了正确系列，默认版本仍可能不是你要买的。

corrections.source: Suppose your picture shows a tote with a zip and a removable strap. One candidate has the same body shape and a magnetic fastening, while another offers a zip but only on a larger version. The first fails the fastening requirement. The second might identify the product family while leaving your intended size uncertain. If size and fastening are both important, request confirmation of that combination before proceeding. If you only sought a similar shape, you may be happy with either. The record should state which question was answered: original source, same apparent model, or a suitable alternative.
corrections.translation: 比如原图是一只有拉链、肩带可拆的托特包。一件候选形状相同但用磁扣，另一件只有大号才有拉链。前者不符合闭合方式，后者可能找对系列却还没确定需要的尺寸。如果尺寸和拉链都重要，就先确认这两项能否同时满足。如果只是想要相似轮廓，两件都可能值得考虑。记录中写清找到的是原来源、看起来同款的商品，还是可接受的替代品。

corrections.source: An available warehouse photograph from another order can show how a unit from a listing looked outside the seller's studio. Check whether the marketplace item and selected option are identifiable. A picture of a navy medium garment can show a seam detail shared by a family, but it cannot tell you the dimensions of an unpictured large. Look for specific evidence you could point to in a dispute: a visible zip, an option label, a pair count, or a readable measurement. Save the reference separately from the pictures of your own future order.
corrections.translation: 别人的入库验货照能展示商品离开卖家摄影棚后的样子。先确认照片对应的商品和规格。藏青色 M 码的图也许能说明同系列的缝制细节，却不能说明未拍到的 L 码尺寸。寻找可以具体指出的证据，例如拉链、规格标签、双数或可读的刻度。把参考图与未来自己这单的照片分开保存。

corrections.source: Technical limitations matter. A bag photographed from one side can hide a second compartment. Shoes seen from above reveal little about outsole construction. A neutral backdrop under strong lighting can make two different colours appear close. Instead of concluding that the search is wrong, identify the missing angle and decide whether obtaining it would change the outcome. If the model identification matters enough, ask the seller or agent a short, checkable question. A request like “please confirm whether the small black version has both the internal zip and the removable strap in this photo” gives the recipient something concrete to verify.
corrections.translation: 单从侧面拍的包可能挡住第二个隔层，鞋的俯拍图看不清外底结构，强光下两种颜色也可能看起来相近。先找出缺哪个角度，再判断补图会不会改变决定。如果区分型号很重要，可以问：“请确认黑色小号是否同时有图中的内拉链和可拆肩带？”具体问题比泛问“是不是同款”更方便对方核实。

corrections.source: When you decide on a candidate, save both the original marketplace link and the USFans link, the seller name, exact option text and date. Add a brief sentence describing the evidence that carried the decision. A spreadsheet entry saying “found it” becomes difficult to interpret once a seller changes the hero image or translates the options differently. A note saying “same pocket shape and cuffs; option B shown with detachable hood; checked seller listing” gives the next review a starting point. Mark what remains uncertain instead of letting it disappear from the shortlist.
corrections.translation: 选好候选后，一并保存原平台网址、USFans 链接、卖家、确切规格名和日期，再写一句决定依据。只写“找到了”，等卖家换主图或规格译名改变就很难复查。比如“口袋和袖口相同；B 款展示可拆帽；已核对卖家商品页”便于日后检查。还没确认的项目也一并标出。

corrections.source: Before purchase, reopen the saved source and reselect the intended option. Check stock, price, quantity and any special requirement on the live order. If a listing disappears between research and payment, return to the saved candidates and repeat only the unresolved identification steps. After warehouse intake, inspect the entry tied to your own order reference. This closes the distance between a photograph you liked and a product you can evaluate. Even when the original seller remains unknown, a transparent record lets you decide whether the available alternative meets your needs without pretending that an image match proved more than it did.
corrections.translation: 付款前重新打开原链接并选中所需规格，检查库存、价格、数量和特殊要求。如果研究到付款之间商品下架，就回到候选表，只重新处理未解决的识别问题。入库后核验属于自己订单号的照片。即使没找到原卖家，仍能据实判断替代品是否合适，无需把搜图相似当作已证实同源。

corrections.source: A custom shirt can arrive with the right name in the wrong position, the correct number in the wrong typeface, or a perfectly legible print on the wrong garment. Separate the information the seller must reproduce from the features the buyer simply expects, and agree on how each will be checked.
corrections.translation: 定制衬衫可能姓名没错却印错位置，号码正确但字体不对，甚至把清晰的图案印在错误款式上。先区分卖家必须逐字复现的内容和买家对成品的其他要求，再约定每项如何验收。

corrections.source: Start at the seller's selected option, rather than the photograph of a finished example. A listing might sell a blank garment, a printed version and the printing service as separate choices. Read the current option description and ask which choice includes the work. Confirm whether the shop accepts the requested characters, accents, punctuation, colours and number of lines. A seller may offer only a fixed alphabet or a preset typeface. An invitation to leave a note does not by itself establish that every element of the design is configurable.
corrections.translation: 从卖家当前选中的规格看起。一个商品页可能把空白衣、已印字版和单独的印字服务作为不同选项出售，先确认哪一项包含加工。询问店铺能否处理指定字符、重音、标点、颜色和行数。有些只支持固定字母表或预设字体。页面能填备注，不代表图案的每个元素都能自定义。

corrections.source: Keep the USFans product link beside the seller listing and chosen option. USFans describes using order remarks for requirements and Order Enquiry for details during purchasing. Those are useful channels for recording a request; a remark alone does not show that the seller accepted it. Ask which details require seller confirmation before production begins. If a change would make the piece unusable, say so explicitly. For example, a club shirt ordered for a group may need the same lettering on every piece, while a single gift may require an accent unavailable in the default character set.
corrections.translation: 把 USFans 链接、原卖家商品页和具体规格一起保存。USFans 提到采购要求可写在订单备注，购买过程中的细节可用订单查询渠道沟通。备注能证明你提出了要求，不能证明卖家已接受。生产前问清哪些细节必须获得确认。比如球队团购可能需要全队字体一致，送人的单件衣服可能必须保留默认字符集中没有的重音，不能接受的变动要提前说明。

corrections.source: Give each custom element a separate line. Identify the base garment, model code, size and colour first. Then provide the exact text as it should appear, including spaces and capitalisation. Label the player's name, back number and sleeve marks separately if the design includes them. Do not rely on quotation marks alone to indicate where text begins and ends; punctuation intended only as a delimiter can be interpreted as literal print. A heading such as “Back name, exactly seven letters” makes the following line easier to read.
corrections.translation: 每项定制内容单独一行。先写基础衣款、型号、尺码和颜色，再给出应印的准确文字，保留空格及大小写。球员姓名、背号和袖标分开标注。不要只用引号界定文字，因为卖家可能把分隔用的标点也印上去。诸如“后背姓名，正好七个字母”的标题，能让下一行更容易核对。

corrections.source: Describe left and right as worn. “Left chest as worn” identifies the wearer's left side even when the photographer faces the garment and sees it on the right of the screen. If the text belongs on a sleeve, specify which sleeve, which direction it should read and whether the reference image has been mirrored. For centred back lettering, identify the centre line and whether the text should sit straight, follow an arc, or align with a panel or stripe. An image with a marked rectangle can help communicate placement when written instructions alone leave two plausible interpretations.
corrections.translation: 左右以穿衣人的身体为准。“穿着时左胸”指穿衣人的左侧，即使摄影者正对衣服，看见的位置在屏幕右边。如果印在袖子上，还要写哪一只袖、阅读方向，以及参考图是否经过镜像。后背居中排字时，说明中心线、排成直线还是弧形、是否要对齐拼片或条纹。如果文字可能有两种理解，在参考图上用矩形框出位置会更清楚。

corrections.source: Only request numerical precision the seller can genuinely offer. A placement instruction measured from a collar seam is clearer than “a little lower,” yet production may still have an agreed tolerance. Ask how the shop measures and which variation it can accept before ordering. On different garment sizes, a fixed width can look relatively larger or smaller. For a group purchase, ask whether design dimensions scale with the garment or stay fixed. Save the actual answer. A mock-up created for a medium shirt might not predict how the same lettering fills the back panel of a much smaller shirt.
corrections.translation: 只要求卖家确实能做到的精度。注明距领口接缝多远，比“稍微低些”明确，但生产仍可能存在双方接受的偏差。先问量法和允许误差。相同的印字宽度在不同尺码的衣服上比例不同；团购时要问图案会不会随衣服放缩，并保存实际答复。M 码衣服的效果图，并不能直接说明相同文字在很小的尺码上占多大面积。

corrections.source: Distinguish a sample image, a digital mock-up for your request and an image of the finished piece. A sample can show available fonts or materials. A digital proof can confirm spelling and layout if the seller supplies one. Only a picture of the completed garment can establish which design ended up on that physical unit. Label the files accordingly. If the seller sends a revised proof, keep its revision date or number. Approve that specific revision in writing and say which earlier instruction it supersedes.
corrections.translation: 分清样品照、本次定制的电子效果图和完工实物照。样品照可展示字体或材质；如卖家提供本次效果图，可用于确认拼写和排版；只有成品照能反映图案最终印在哪件实物上。分别命名文件。如有修订版，保留日期或版本号，书面确认具体哪一版并说明它替代了哪条旧要求。

corrections.source: For several garments, use a row per item. Place each row's buyer reference, base garment, size, colour, name and number together. Read across the row to check that each set of details belongs to the same piece, then read down the name and number columns to catch accidental duplicates or shifted lines. A common mistake is producing every requested name and every requested number, but pairing two names with the opposite numbers. Recording the complete combination per unit prevents that error from disappearing inside a list of individually correct totals.
corrections.translation: 定制多件衣服时，每件占一行，写上买家自编编号、衣款、尺码、颜色、姓名和号码。先横向读完一行，确认这些信息属于同一件；再沿姓名和号码两列向下看，检查重复或错行。所有姓名和号码都印全了，也可能出现两人的背号互换。逐件核对组合才不会让这类错误藏在“总数都对”后面。

corrections.source: Ask for the amount attributable to the base item and the amount attributable to custom work. Check whether a price covers one printed area, several lines, both sides or each individual garment. If the seller sends a separate payment link for printing, establish exactly which base order it belongs to. Keep one written record of the agreed quantity, option and total in the original currency. If more than one party has to approve a proof, avoid submitting contradictory responses from separate conversations.
corrections.translation: 分别询问基础衣价和加工费。确认报价是一个印区、几行文字、正反面，还是按每件衣服计费。如果另发印字付款链接，先弄清对应哪张基础订单。用原币种把数量、规格和总额集中写在一份记录里。需要多人确认效果图时，避免在不同会话里给出矛盾意见。

corrections.source: Before authorizing work, check the current seller and agent conditions for changes, cancellations and returns on personalised items. The timing matters: correcting a note while the seller is checking availability can be different from asking for a change after printing. Do not assume that a normal return arrangement applies to custom work, or that every error has the same remedy. If the seller cannot confirm an essential detail before starting, consider waiting. A clearly documented decision to proceed without a proof is still a decision about uncertainty, and it should be made by the person who will use the garment.
corrections.translation: 开始加工前，核对卖家和代购平台当前对定制品修改、取消与退货的规定。卖家查库存时改备注，和印完再改，处理条件可能完全不同。定制品未必适用普通商品的退货方式，各种错误的处理也不一定相同。必要细节未经确认时，可以等。若选择不看校样直接生产，就清楚记录这项决定，并让最终使用衣服的人判断能否接受不确定性。

corrections.source: At warehouse intake, check the base garment first. Read the size label, option and identifying features, then compare the full design with the approved proof. Read the text character by character, including punctuation and accents. Check leading zeros, line order and which side of the garment carries the print. Use an overall view for alignment and a closer view for small letters. If the entire photograph seems reversed, look at another readable object in the frame or request a different view before treating the print itself as reversed.
corrections.translation: 入库先验基础衣款：看尺码标、规格和辨识特征，再将完整图案与已确认的效果图比对。逐字核对，包括标点、重音和前导零；检查行序及所印的一面。用全景看对齐，用近照看小字。若整张照片像是左右颠倒，先找画面中另一个可读物或另要角度，别把照片镜像直接判定为印反。

corrections.source: Before closing the record, check the spelling one final time against its intended source, such as the spelling supplied by the person receiving the garment. A perfect match between the seller proof and the finished piece can still reproduce a mistake in the buyer's first message. Saving that original instruction makes the source of a discrepancy clear and helps avoid placing a repeat order with the same error.
corrections.translation: 结束前，与收衣人最初提供的拼法再核对一次。成衣和卖家的效果图即使完全相同，也可能一起沿用了买家第一条消息中的错字。留存原始指示有助于追溯差异，也能避免补订时重复同一个错误。

corrections.source: A photograph can show a jacket, trousers and a belt even when the option currently selected buys just the belt. Read the offer as a list of included pieces, then check the quantity arriving at the warehouse against that original list.
corrections.translation: 主图可能同时拍了外套、裤子和腰带，而当前选项只卖腰带。把所选规格拆成“实际包含哪些件”，再用这张清单核对入库数量。

corrections.source: Start by deciding which pieces you intend to buy. A matching outfit can involve a complete set sold under one option, individually priced separates, or a choice between those arrangements. If your goal is a coordinated jacket and trouser combination, write down the style, colour and size you need for each. Someone who wears different jacket and trouser sizes may find a fixed-size set unsuitable even when the individual pieces look perfect. Knowing that requirement in advance helps you identify the question worth asking before purchase.
corrections.translation: 先列出准备购买的部分。同款搭配可能整套出售、分开标价，也可能两种都能选。要搭成外套和裤装，就分别写下需要的款式、颜色及尺码。如果上下装需要不同码，即使单件看着合适，固定同码套装也未必能穿。明确这个条件，才知道付款前最值得问什么。

corrections.source: Review the seller's live offer and keep its link beside the USFans page. Inspect the text attached to the chosen option, the option image, unit price and quantity. The main photograph may stay the same while the purchase changes from trousers only to a two-piece combination. Change one selector at a time and observe what changes in the summary. If the price drops sharply when you select an accessory, check the name of the unit before assuming the whole outfit has been discounted. Record enough detail to reopen the offer and reproduce the same selection later.
corrections.translation: 把卖家实时商品页和 USFans 页面放在一起，检查选中规格的文字、图、单价和数量。从单条裤子切到两件套时，主图可能始终不变。每次只切一个选项，观察订单摘要哪里发生变化。如果点配件后价格大幅下降，先查单位名称，别误以为整套降价。留下足够细节，便于日后重新选中完全相同的规格。

corrections.source: Look for a menu that describes the contents separately from colour and size. A label translated as “suit” might refer to a full set, a suit-style jacket or a product family. Inspect any original seller text, model code or explanatory chart that ties a particular option to the included items. If the description and the selected picture disagree, ask for a count and name of the pieces. “Does option B include one top and one pair of trousers?” leaves less room for misunderstanding than “does it come like the photo?”
corrections.translation: 找能明确说明“含哪些件”的规格菜单，不要只看颜色与尺码。译作“套装”的词可能指整套，也可能指西装风外套或商品系列。核对卖家原文、型号及配件说明表。如果选择图和说明不一致，直接问数量和名称：“B 选项是否包含一件上衣和一条裤子？”比只问“跟图片一样吗”更清楚。

corrections.source: Suppose the seller offers top only in small through large, trousers only in the same three sizes, and complete sets in medium or large. For a small top and medium trousers, a buyer might need two separate selections rather than one complete set. Compare the actual cost, quantity, availability and seller's willingness to supply the intended combination. If two colours carry similar translations, make sure the shades are intended to coordinate. Two pieces from unrelated listings marketed under the same English colour name can be made of different fabrics or dyed to different shades.
corrections.translation: 举例说，卖家单卖的上衣和裤子分别有 S、M、L 三码，整套却只卖 M 和 L。若需要 S 码上衣配 M 码裤子，可能要分两项下单。比较实际总价、数量、库存，并确认卖家愿意这样搭配。若两种颜色译名相近，也要问是否设计成可搭配的同色系。不同商品页即使使用同一英文色名，面料或染色也可能不同。

corrections.source: For a fixed set, record the set option, selected colour, size and number of sets, followed by the expected pieces in each. For separates, use one line per variant and link them with a short reference such as “outfit A.” Include relevant size codes exactly as displayed by the seller. USFans's beginner guide describes selecting options and quantities and using remarks for purchasing requirements. A concise note provides context if the agent or seller has to ask about stock, mismatched sizes or a proposed substitution.
corrections.translation: 固定套装要记下套装规格、颜色、尺码、套数和每套的预期组成。分开买则每种规格单列，用“搭配 A”等编号将各行联系起来。卖家尺码代码按原样保留。USFans 新手指南说明可选择规格和数量，并用备注写采购要求。简单清楚的备注能在缺货、混码或需要替换时帮代购与卖家还原原意。

corrections.source: Define which substitutions require your decision. If the jacket is out of stock, would you still want the trousers? If the set in navy is unavailable, would black be acceptable for both pieces or only one? Write “please ask before purchasing only part of the outfit” when a partial order would defeat your purpose. Check the seller's actual options if a component becomes unavailable. A complete set price may no longer apply if the seller can supply just one piece. Save the revised description and total before agreeing to a different purchase.
corrections.translation: 提前说明哪些替换必须先问你。外套缺货，还要不要裤子？藏青色缺货，能否两件一起换黑，还是仅一件能换？如果只买部分就失去意义，直接写“仅能购买部分套装时，请先询问”。缺件后重新确认卖家可供选项；只供一件时整套价可能不再适用。保存新说明和新总价后再接受变更。

corrections.source: When a warehouse entry appears, identify which order and domestic shipment it belongs to. A top and trousers purchased separately may arrive in different bags or shipments. A complete set may be packed together and show as one warehouse entry. Neither pattern alone proves a shortage. Compare the expected contents with the entry and its photographs. Look for a view showing the pieces together and separate label views if the sizes matter. If a tiny accessory is missing from the overview, ask whether it is inside a pocket or separate protective sleeve before reporting it as absent.
corrections.translation: 出现入库记录时，先认清对应订单与国内包裹。分开买的上衣、裤子可能分袋或分票到达，整套则可能装一起、只显示一条记录，这两种情况本身都不能证明少货。把预期清单和入库照片比对。尽量找同框全景；尺码重要时再看各件标签。小配饰没有出现在总览图里，先问是否在口袋或单独保护套中。

corrections.source: Use a component list for matching sets with complex construction. For a three-piece weatherproof outfit it might read outer jacket, removable liner and trousers. An assembled jacket can hide the liner attachment in a folded photo. Request the view that will answer the question, such as the inner fasteners or the pieces laid out separately. Look at colour consistency in the same frame under the same light when possible. A dark jacket photographed in daylight and dark trousers photographed under warmer warehouse lighting may look different even if the cloth matches.
corrections.translation: 结构复杂的套装按部件列清单。例如三件式防风雨搭配包含外套、可拆内胆和裤子。外套折叠、内胆装好时，看不见连接处很正常。需要判断内胆就请拍内侧扣件，或将部件分开平放。在可能的情况下，将整套放进同一画面、同一照明下看颜色。分别在日光和偏暖仓库灯光下拍摄的深色上衣及裤子，即便面料相同也可能有色差。

corrections.source: If a component appears wrong, tell USFans which paid option you selected, what it included and which piece differs. Attach the seller description and a warehouse picture that identifies the affected unit. Ask what the seller requires if a return or exchange is possible. A seller could require the full set, including packaging, even when only one piece has an issue. Check the current terms and preserve everything while the answer is pending. Avoid authorizing packaging removal or dispatching one piece internationally if it might be needed for the same case.
corrections.translation: 某个部件不对时，告诉 USFans 已付的具体规格、应包含什么、哪件有差别，并附卖家说明与可辨认该件的入库照。若能退换，先问卖家要求寄回哪些东西。即使只有一件有问题，卖家也可能要求完整套装和原包装。等答复时把物品都保留好；可能同属售后案件的部件，不要提前拆弃包装或单独寄往国外。

corrections.source: Finally, record the actual number of physical pieces you are sending and which warehouse entries contain them. If an exchange replaces only the trousers, inspect the replacement colour and size against the jacket you retained. If the seller refunds an absent belt, mark the belt as resolved by refund rather than received. When you eventually open the outbound parcel, the record should show the intended outfit, any agreed changes and the pieces that actually travelled. That makes a set intelligible from the original photograph through purchase, inspection and international delivery.
corrections.translation: 最终记清实际寄出的实物件数和它们所属的入库条目。如果只换了裤子，把新裤的颜色和尺码与保留的外套再核对。缺失的腰带若由卖家退款，应记为“已退款解决”，不能记成“已收到”。打开国际包裹时，记录应能还原原本想要的整套搭配、商定的变动及确实寄出的物品。

corrections.source: A useful final test is whether someone opening the parcel without the original model picture could tell what belongs together. A description such as “grey set B, one short jacket and one straight trouser, detachable belt inside the jacket pocket” passes that test. A description such as “grey outfit from the first photo” leaves almost every important feature implicit. This also helps with repeat purchases when only one worn component needs replacing and the seller still lists the separates.
corrections.translation: 可以让没有看过模特原图的人试着读装箱说明。“灰色 B 套装，短外套一件、直筒裤一条，可拆腰带放在外套口袋里”，足以说明哪些件属于同一套。“第一张图的灰色搭配”则缺少关键信息。以后只想补买其中穿坏的一件，而卖家仍有单卖时，具体记录同样有用。

corrections.source: An EU size printed on a shoe and a length photographed on a ruler answer different questions. To use either one well, match the shoe, measurement method and intended fit before comparing numbers. A cropped picture of a number beside a shoe rarely resolves all three.
corrections.translation: 鞋标上的欧码和尺子量出的长度回答的是两个问题。要用好这两个数据，先确认对应哪双鞋、怎样量，以及想达到什么穿着效果。只截取鞋边的一个刻度，通常不足以同时核实这三点。

corrections.source: Foot length describes a person. Removable insole length describes an insert. Internal shoe length concerns the space inside a shoe and can be difficult to measure accurately. Outsole length includes material outside that space. A seller's chart might use any of these, or might only show conversions between size systems. Read the chart heading and diagram before interpreting a centimetre value. When the chart simply says “length,” look for the endpoints in the diagram or ask what was measured. Converting a number to another unit does nothing to fix a mismatch between two different measurements.
corrections.translation: 脚长量的是人，可拆鞋垫长度量的是鞋垫，鞋内长指鞋内空间，较难准确测量。鞋底外长则包括脚能用到的空间之外的材料。卖家尺码表可能采用其中任何一项，或只列不同尺码体系的对应关系。读清表头和量法图；只写“长度”时，就找示意图的起止点，或直接询问。把厘米换成毫米，并不能把鞋底外长变成鞋内长。

corrections.source: State the intended use in your own notes. A close-fitting court shoe, a cushioned walking shoe and a boot worn with thick socks can feel different even when two removable insoles measure the same length. Width, toe-box shape, volume and the heel construction can matter as much as length. Pick the unresolved question. If you already know the model and only need to verify the supplied size, a readable label might suffice. If the listing uses an unfamiliar chart and fit is the deciding factor, a measurement gathered with a clear method could be worth requesting.
corrections.translation: 先记下用途。贴脚的场地鞋、带缓震的步行鞋和配厚袜穿的靴子，即使两副可拆鞋垫同长，感受也会不同。宽度、鞋头形状、鞋腔空间和后跟结构都可能与长度同样重要。已熟悉型号、只想确认发对码数，也许看清标签就够了；若尺码表陌生而合脚与否决定是否购买，就值得请求按明确方法测量。

corrections.source: Choose a shoe you wear comfortably for the same activity. If it has a removable insert that comes out without damage, take it out and note its shape. Place it on a flat surface and measure the straight distance from the rear edge at the heel to the longest point of the toe. Keep the ordinary shape of the insert and avoid pulling it longer. If the insert is contoured, note how you positioned it. Take a photograph showing the ruler and the entire insert, so that later you can ask for a comparable view.
corrections.translation: 选平时做同样活动时穿得舒服的鞋。若鞋垫可以轻松取出、不损伤鞋子，取出后注意它的形状，放在平面上，量后跟最末端到前掌最长点的直线距离。让鞋垫保持自然形状，不要拉长。若它自带弧度，记下如何摆放。拍一张尺子和整块鞋垫都在同一画面内的照片，便于之后要求相同视角。

corrections.source: Record the reference shoe's marked size and system, the measured length, which side you measured and the unit. If the reference insert has a different outline or thickness from the new shoe, write that down too. A narrow pointed toe and a broad rounded toe can create different usable space despite matching overall length. Measuring a foot is a separate exercise. If you decide to use a seller's foot-length chart, follow its specified method and compare your foot to that chart rather than silently converting an insole measurement into a body measurement.
corrections.translation: 记下参照鞋的尺码体系、标注尺码、实测长度、量的是左脚还是右脚及单位。若鞋垫轮廓和厚度与新鞋明显不同，也要说明。尖窄鞋头和宽圆鞋头，即使量出相同长度，脚趾可用空间也可能不同。如果卖家的表按脚长推荐尺码，就将实测脚长与之比较，别把鞋垫长度当作人体尺寸。

corrections.source: Open the USFans order or warehouse record and confirm the exact seller option, colour and size. Two sizes of the same model can be impossible to distinguish from a front photograph. A picture from a similar pair on a spreadsheet is useful for deciding what to ask but does not identify what arrived for your order. Note the warehouse reference along with the seller item ID. Include the current order reference in an inquiry so the agent knows which physical pair requires attention.
corrections.translation: 打开 USFans 订单或入库记录，确认卖家规格、颜色和尺码。同款不同码的鞋从正面看可能一模一样。表格中别人的相似鞋照能帮助你决定问什么，却不能证明这双实物量出来是多少。询问时附当前订单或入库编号，让工作人员知道要检查哪双。

corrections.source: USFans's beginner guide describes inspection at warehouse receipt and access to stored items. Use the current order channel to check whether a particular measurement or additional photograph is available. Establish any fee before requesting the service. Ask the handler to remove an insert only if it is designed to come out easily and the requested handling is permitted. Glued or fixed components should stay in place. In that situation, choose an alternative source of evidence, such as a readable size label or a clearly described internal measurement, and record what method was actually used.
corrections.translation: USFans 新手指南介绍了到仓验货和查看入库商品的方法。向当前订单渠道确认能否提供具体测量或额外照片，并先问清费用。只有鞋垫能正常取出时才请取出，不要要求强行剥离粘牢的鞋垫。若无法取出，可以改要清楚的鞋标或询问可行的鞋内测量，并记录实际采用的方法。

corrections.source: A useful request might say, “For the blue pair in this warehouse entry, please show the marked size and, if the insert is readily removable, photograph one insert beside a metric ruler. Show the heel edge, longest toe point, zero mark and final reading together.” This separates identification from measurement. If the handler can supply two pictures, use one overview for the whole arrangement and a closer image only when needed to read small markings. A close-up alone can make a wrong endpoint appear convincing.
corrections.translation: 例如可写：“请核对该入库编号下的蓝色鞋，拍清鞋标尺码。若鞋垫可以轻松取出，请取出一只，放在公制尺旁，让后跟边缘、脚尖最长点、零刻度和终点读数同框。”这样同时明确了身份和量法。必要时补一张近照读细刻度，但只看近照可能把错误的终点误认为正确。

corrections.source: Check the returned picture before interpreting it. Is the ruler straight and in the same plane as the insert? Is the zero at the edge or beyond it? Is the final reading in centimetres or inches? A ruler positioned at an angle or photographed from the side can create an apparent difference. Some rulers begin before their printed zero. If the heel aligns with one centimetre and the toe with twenty-eight centimetres, the observed interval is twenty-seven centimetres. That example illustrates why the two endpoints matter more than the final numeral.
corrections.translation: 拿到照片先检查：尺子是否摆正，与鞋垫是否在同一平面，零刻度是否贴着边缘，单位是厘米还是英寸。斜放尺子或从侧面拍摄都可能造成视觉差异。有些尺子的实体边缘早于印刷零点。比如后跟在 1 厘米处，前掌在 28 厘米处，实际间距是 27 厘米，而非 28 厘米。这就是为何要同时看到两个端点。

corrections.source: If one photo shows an outsole and the other a removed insert, suspend the comparison. Explain which view you need and why. If both show inserts but one has a high heel cup that will not lie flat, ask how it was positioned and reproduce the same method on your reference shoe if possible. A result that remains uncertain is still informative: you know what the available evidence cannot establish. It is safer to make a conscious choice on limited evidence than to misread an incompatible number as reassurance.
corrections.translation: 一张量鞋底、一张量取出的鞋垫，就先停下比较，说明需要哪种图。如果都量鞋垫，其中一只的后跟杯很高、不能平放，询问摆放方法，并在参照鞋垫上照样测量。方法无法对应时，要承认照片能说明的有限；在信息有限时作决定，好过把两个不可比的数字当作合脚的保证。

corrections.source: When the marked size, seller chart and comparable measurement all point in the same direction, note that agreement with the order. If the marked size matches but the insert differs substantially, inspect whether the chart referred to foot length, whether the seller changed model construction or whether there is a reference error. If the size label is visibly wrong, send the paid selection and the label photo together. Describe the discrepancy without speculating about why it occurred. Request the options available for the current order while the pair is still accessible for inspection.
corrections.translation: 鞋标、卖家尺码表和可比测量都指向同一结果，就将一致之处记入订单。如果鞋标正确但鞋垫长度明显不同，检查尺码表是否其实量脚长、型号结构是否变化，或参照物是否认错。若鞋标本身就不符，附上已付款的规格与实物标签照，直接指出差异，不猜原因。趁商品仍在仓库可检查，询问本单可用的处理选项。

corrections.source: Keep the packaging and any supplied inserts together until the question is settled. If you consider returning or exchanging the pair, check the applicable seller and agent conditions before altering or discarding anything. If you proceed with shipping despite an unresolved width or shape question, record that as part of the decision. Later, when you try the pair on, note which measurement predicted the fit and which limitation mattered. That small piece of first-hand evidence can make the next comparison more informative than another list of size conversions copied from an unrelated listing.
corrections.translation: 问题解决前，把包装、鞋子和随附鞋垫一起保留。考虑退换时，先核对卖家与代购平台的适用条件，再决定是否改动或丢弃材料。若明知宽度或鞋型仍不确定而选择发货，也记入决定。日后试穿后，写下哪个尺寸有效、哪项限制影响了穿着，往往比保存另一张无关商品的换码表更能帮助下次选择。

corrections.source: Preserve the date and model code as well. A later version of a similarly named shoe may use a different last, insert or upper construction, and its chart deserves a fresh check.
corrections.translation: 同时记下日期和型号代码。之后同名鞋的新版本可能改用不同鞋楦、鞋垫或鞋面结构，需要重新核对尺码表。

corrections.source: Record whether you wore a separate insert or a particularly thick sock during the comparison. A buyer replacing the supplied insert with their own will make a different fit decision from someone evaluating the shoe exactly as supplied.
corrections.translation: 记录试穿参照鞋时是否使用自备鞋垫、是否穿厚袜。计划换上自己鞋垫的人，与打算按出厂配置穿着的人，合脚标准可能不同。

corrections.source: When five shopping-cart lines turn into three warehouse records and one international parcel, a count of references stops being a count of physical items. Build the relationship from the items outward so you can tell what was packed, what is still waiting and what any later tracking update refers to.
corrections.translation: 五行购物车商品最后可能对应三条入库记录、一个国际包裹，编号数量已经不等于实物数量。从每件实物出发建立对应关系，才能说明哪些已装箱、哪些还在等，以及后面的物流动态对应哪一程。

corrections.source: Read each paid selection and write down what the seller agreed to supply. Include size, colour, quantity and whether the selected unit contains several pieces. Two pairs of socks and one two-piece outfit may be three order units but six individual pieces if you count each sock and each garment separately. Choose the counting unit that helps you check delivery and write it beside the number. “Two retail pairs” is clearer than “two” when reconciling small items. Keep the product link for identification but use the paid option as the primary description of the actual order.
corrections.translation: 按每个已付规格逐行写明卖家承诺提供什么，包括尺码、颜色、数量及一个销售单位里含几件。举例说，两双袜子加一套两件式衣服按购买单位是三份，把每只袜子和每件衣服分别算则是六件实物。选择便于验收的单位，写在数量旁边。“两双零售装袜子”比单写“二”清楚。商品链接用于识别，实物应以已付规格为准。

corrections.source: For each seller shipment, record the seller name, domestic carrier and tracking number if given. Identify the associated paid items and mark whether the seller claims the shipment is complete or split. A carrier delivery scan confirms a transport event for that package. The USFans warehouse entry is a separate event linking received goods to your account. A package can reach the facility before all its items appear in the warehouse view. If a shipment appears missing, begin with the last stage you can verify instead of assuming the international parcel is delayed.
corrections.translation: 对每个卖家包裹记下店铺、国内快递和已提供的单号，关联对应实物，并区分卖家声称一次发齐还是分包。快递签收只能证明这个包裹发生了运输事件，USFans 入库则是收到的货与账户建立关联的另一个事件。包裹到达设施时，全部商品未必已经显示。若有物品没找到，从最后能核实的一步查起，不要直接认定国际包裹延误。

corrections.source: Use warehouse photographs and option labels to match received entries to your intended-piece list. A photograph of a plain black T-shirt may not distinguish two sizes. Check the visible label or ask which entry corresponds to which size. If a single warehouse record contains multiple pieces, annotate the relationship beside that record. If one outfit arrives in two shipments, list both warehouse references beside the outfit label. This simple many-to-many mapping reduces the temptation to tick an entire order as complete as soon as its first component appears.
corrections.translation: 用仓库照片和规格标签把实收条目对应到预期实物清单。普通黑 T 恤的正面照可能分不出两个尺码，应查标签或询问哪条入库记录对应哪个码。一条入库记录可能包含几个部件，也可能多张图只是同一件货的不同角度。写明能看到哪些物件，哪项仍未核实，避免第一件一出现就把整个订单勾为完成。

corrections.source: Before submitting anything, review the state of each intended piece. Separate items you have accepted from items awaiting clarification, a further photo, a return or an exchange. Read any storage deadline against the individual warehouse entry. Waiting briefly for one delivery might be sensible, while waiting for every future order can create a storage or after-sales problem for earlier arrivals. USFans describes stored items under Warehouse and outgoing shipments as parcels. Use the live status in the appropriate part of your account rather than inferring readiness from the seller's marketplace page.
corrections.translation: 提交出库前，逐件查看状态。已验收的商品与等待澄清、补拍、退货或换货的商品分开，并查看每个入库条目的仓储期限。等一个包裹不一定意味着其他物品都能继续放同样久。在账户相应页面查实际状态，不要仅凭卖家的原商品页推断已可出库。

corrections.source: Think about the physical dependencies between entries. If a removable hood was supplied separately from a jacket, both pieces need to travel if the outfit is to be used as intended. Conversely, a replacement garment and the original garment awaiting return should not both enter the same outbound parcel simply because they look similar. Mark the exact item to go and the action still pending on the other. Review route eligibility and packing needs for all selected contents, especially where one item could affect the route choice or protection needed for the rest.
corrections.translation: 有些条目必须一起走，例如外套与另行寄到的可拆帽子；有些则不应一起走，例如原件仍待退货的替换服装。勾选时检查这些实际依赖关系。若某件货会影响整箱可走的路线或所需保护，也应在合箱前根据真实内容核对。

corrections.source: Write a short packing manifest before submitting the parcel. Include each warehouse reference, item description and physical quantity. Note whether retail packaging is to remain, any protection you requested and any accessory expected inside a larger item. Save a copy before changing the selection. When the outbound parcel reference is issued, add it to the manifest. Keep the route, destination and date next to that reference. A written content list makes a future support message much easier to interpret than a series of screenshots with no explanation of which stage they depict.
corrections.translation: 出库前列一份简明装箱清单，写入每个入库编号、商品说明和实物数量。注明零售包装是否保留、申请的保护措施，以及哪件大货内预计有小配件。提交前保留一份副本；若后来调整，记录日期和原因。比起一串分不清所处阶段的截图，这样更容易在收货时还原最终选择。

corrections.source: Consider an example with four wearable items. Warehouse entry A holds a jacket with its detachable hood. Entry B contains two shirts, size small and medium. Entry C is a cap that has yet to arrive. If you submit A and B today, the parcel covers three wearable items plus the hood that belongs to the jacket. C stays outside this shipment. Record the cap as pending rather than lost. If the two shirts are folded together inside the same protective bag, note that packaging arrangement so you know what to look for when the parcel is opened.
corrections.translation: 假设要买四件可穿戴物品。入库 A 是一件外套及可拆帽，B 是 S 码和 M 码衬衫各一件，C 是尚未到仓的帽子。今天只提交 A 和 B，包裹应有三件衣服，加上属于外套的可拆帽。C 仍未入仓，应记“待到货”。若两件衬衫叠在同一保护袋里，记下这层包装关系，收货时就知道要在哪里找。

corrections.source: The manifest identifies what you intend to ship. The parcel measurements describe the packed result. Keep item-level weights, package dimensions and outbound billing information distinct. Adding individual estimates will not necessarily reproduce the measured weight of the final box because packing materials, removed packaging or later adjustments can change it. If the final figure seems surprising, first compare the actual selected contents with your own manifest. An extra warehouse entry or a retained retail box may explain an apparent difference without any carrier error.
corrections.translation: 装箱清单说明想寄什么，包裹测量记录说明装好后实际多大、多重。单件重量、包装尺寸和出库计费数据应分开保留。单品估重相加未必等于装箱后的重量，保护材料、保留的零售盒和实际入选的仓库条目都可能造成差异。先核对组成，别只凭一处数字不同就认定快递计费错误。

corrections.source: Track the outbound shipment using the carrier and reference shown for that parcel. A domestic seller number may already show delivered, even while the international parcel is only being prepared. If a carrier hands the parcel to a local delivery partner, record the second number against the same manifest when the tracking information identifies it. A new tracking reference does not automatically mean a second physical parcel exists. Look for confirmation of a split or additional package before creating an extra entry in your inventory or assuming something was left behind.
corrections.translation: 国际段用该包裹显示的承运商和单号查询。国际包裹还在准备时，国内卖家寄来的包裹已经显示“签收”很正常。如果中途转交当地派送公司，把第二个单号关联到原包裹。确认是否同一件实物包裹后，再决定是否需要新增记录，避免把单号变动当成另起一箱或漏寄。

corrections.source: When the parcel arrives, keep the outer packaging and label while checking the contents against your list. Locate each item, its option and any small accessories that might be tucked inside retail packaging. If a piece appears absent, compare the warehouse photo and packing instruction before discarding wrapping. Record whether the outer parcel arrived damaged, whether interior packing was disturbed and what remains present. A photograph showing the whole contents beside the packaging is useful context for closer images of a missing set component or damaged item.
corrections.translation: 包裹到达后先保留外包装和面单，按照清单找每一件实物、对应规格和可能藏在零售包装里的小配件。看似少货时，先对照装箱说明和仓库照片，查明原先怎么摆放。拍一张包装与到货全貌同框的照片，再补拍缺件所在的套装或损坏部位，方便说明前后情况。

corrections.source: If a discrepancy remains, contact the relevant support channel with the outbound parcel reference, the affected warehouse reference and the missing or incorrect piece. Explain what had been confirmed before dispatch and what you observed at delivery. Keep unrelated pending seller shipments separate from the case. Once everything is reconciled, mark each physical item received, refunded, replaced or still pending. The final manifest then tells a reliable story from original purchase to arrival, even when the number of cart lines, warehouse entries and carrier references never matched.
corrections.translation: 若差异仍在，向相应渠道提供出库包裹号、受影响的入库编号和缺失或不符的具体物件。说明发货前确认过什么、收货时实际看到什么，把其他尚未入库的订单另列。即使购物车行数、仓库记录和快递单号数量各不相同，这条记录仍能从购买一路追到收货。

corrections.source: For a shared purchase, also identify who expects each item without putting unnecessary personal details in a public spreadsheet. A private initial or order label is enough.
