Record how any shared shipping amount was apportioned separately from the carrier charge itself. This prevents an internal budget calculation from being mistaken later for an actual cost billed on a specific warehouse entry.
corrections.translation: 多人合购时另外记录每件归谁，不必在公开表格放个人资料，私下使用姓名首字母或订单代号即可。大家如何分摊运费与快递实际向整个包裹收取多少也要分开记。这样以后业务核对时，不会把个人预算分摊误认为仓库对某一件商品单独计费。

corrections.source: Start at the live marketplace listing linked from the USFans page. Write down the shop, item identifier, selected size and original colour wording. Include any suffix, model code or number printed beside the colour. Sellers sometimes use colour selectors to distinguish construction, material, size ranges or packages as well as hue. Two options translated to “black” can represent different linings or versions. Keep the original wording and the translated description beside each other so that a later change in translation does not erase the distinction you used to choose.
corrections.translation: 从 USFans 页面打开对应的原平台商品，记下店铺、商品编号、已选尺码和颜色原文。颜色名旁的后缀、型号和数字也要保留。卖家可能用同一个颜色菜单区分结构、材质、尺码范围甚至套装内容。两个都译作“黑色”的选项，可能采用不同内衬。把原文与译名并列，避免以后翻译变化抹去当初选款的依据。

corrections.source: Now choose a neighbouring swatch and watch what happens. Does the selected text change? Does the main photograph change? Does moving back to the desired option restore both the previous picture and the price? This checks that the selected state is tied to the intended option rather than simply viewing the next image in a gallery. Save a screenshot that shows the selected label together with the item, size and visible identifying details. A crop containing only a square of colour gives someone reviewing an order little basis for choosing the correct version.
corrections.translation: 点选相邻色块，观察选项文字和主图是否变化，再点回目标规格，检查是否恢复原来的代码和图片。保存能看出选中状态的完整画面，不要只截一小块颜色。之后复查的人需要辨认具体版本；单看一块近似色很难知道当初点的是哪项。

corrections.source: Colour words rarely map neatly from one language to another. A seller may use a marketing name, a factory code and an everyday colour description together. A translated “rice white” and “white” might indicate a warmer cream and a brighter white, or the text may refer to two entirely different versions. Treat this as a question about the seller's catalogue. Search for another labelled image or swatch within that listing, and compare how the seller uses the same words across adjacent options. Avoid imposing your preferred interpretation of a marketing name on the actual offer.
corrections.translation: 颜色词很少能在两种语言里一一对应。卖家可能同时用营销名、工厂代码和日常色名。机器翻译有时会把两个近似名称变成同一个词，或把颜色名解释成人名、材质。保留原词，根据它在该商品选项中的实际含义核对，别把自己对营销名称的理解当作卖家的承诺。

corrections.source: Suppose a listing includes navy A and navy B. One promotional picture shows contrast stitching and another shows matching stitching. The wearable distinction you care about might be stitching, even though the selector calls both options navy. Ask “Which navy option has the contrast stitching shown beside the zip?” instead of “Which blue is darker?” A concrete feature gives the seller a way to identify the option even under different lighting. If no physical feature separates the two choices in the pictures, ask for a labelled side-by-side view or code confirmation where available before paying.
corrections.translation: 假设有藏青 A、藏青 B，一个用撞色缝线，一个用同色缝线。穿在身上真正有区别的可能是缝线，不是两个色样的微小明度差。如果照片没有标明哪个版本对应哪种缝线，能询问时先要标明规格的同框图或代码确认，再付款。

corrections.source: Compare more than one image of the same option. Check whether the seller edited some pictures heavily or photographed the garment against strongly coloured backgrounds. Daylight, warm indoor light and camera processing can change the appearance of a neutral item in opposite directions. Your display settings add another variable. Identify differences that remain visible across views: a contrasting cuff, two-tone panel, differently coloured zip or distinct fabric weave. These can be more reliable identifiers than the apparent saturation of one image.
corrections.translation: 多看同规格的几张照片，检查是否经过重度调色或用了颜色很强的背景。屏幕、光线和后期都会改变色彩感受。先找较稳定的识别特征，例如饰边、拉链颜色、印花位置或织物纹理。用它们分辨版本，常比比较单张照片的饱和度可靠。

corrections.source: If matching another garment matters, work with evidence in the same frame where possible. A pair of trousers photographed under warm warehouse lights and a jacket photographed outdoors are poor material for an exact shade comparison. A request for both pieces together in one picture may resolve whether they visibly coordinate, provided both are available and belong to the correct orders. Even then, fabric texture and direction can affect how the same dye looks on camera. Decide in advance whether you need exact shade matching or simply two pieces that look acceptable together.
corrections.translation: 需要和另一件衣服配色时，尽量看同框、同光线的实物。暖灯下的裤子和另一场景下的外套，即使相同色料也可能看起来不同。同框照能降低比较难度，仍不是精确色值证明。先确认目标是严格同色，还是只要两件穿在一起协调。

corrections.source: USFans describes choosing colour, size and quantity before submitting an order. After selecting the desired combination, inspect the cart and final summary. A saved product link may reopen on the seller's default option, so recheck just before paying. In the order note, record the seller's original option text, the option code and a short description of the distinguishing feature. If you are ordering multiple colours, state the desired quantity for each on separate lines. A note saying “one of each” becomes unclear as soon as a seller adds, removes or reorders swatches.
corrections.translation: USFans 说明在提交订单前选择颜色、尺码和数量。选好后检查购物车与最终摘要，确保这一条对应正确规格。买多个颜色时逐行写明，不要只说“每种一个”。卖家增加、删除或调整色块顺序后，这句话就可能对应不同的商品。

corrections.source: Once the order arrives, open the photographs associated with that order or warehouse entry. Compare the option label or packaging code with the confirmation first. Then inspect the relevant visible feature and overall appearance. If the code and construction match but the hue looks unexpected, seek another view before concluding that the physical item is wrong. If the label clearly names a different option, include that label and the paid selection in an order inquiry. The evidence for a different code is stronger than two pictures that merely look different on your screen.
corrections.translation: 到仓后打开这单或这个入库编号下的照片。先比对实物标签、包装代码和已确认选项，再观察灯光下的颜色。标签与订单代码不一致，是比两张图片在屏幕上看起来色差很大更直接的发货差异证据。

corrections.source: Ask a specific question if the first photo cannot resolve an important distinction. “Please show the option label and both sides of the sleeve stripe on warehouse item [reference]” identifies actionable evidence. “Please prove the colour is right” leaves the photographer guessing at lighting, angle and the buyer's expectation. Check availability and terms of any additional service in the live order. If the garment is sealed and opening it might matter to a return, ask before authorizing opening. Keep the deadline and conditions for any after-sales decision separate from the storage period for that item.
corrections.translation: 若首张照片无法区分关键版本，就指定视角，例如“请拍清该入库条目的规格标签，以及袖子条纹的两侧”。询问可拍范围、费用和当前还能执行的操作。售后必须在何时作决定、需要满足什么条件，与该商品能在仓库保管多久是不同的问题。

corrections.source: Before approving international shipment, put the evidence into three groups: what you ordered, what the received item's label says, and how the item looks in the available lighting. If all three point to the intended option, record the result. If the first and second disagree, ask the agent to check fulfilment. If the label matches but the appearance remains uncertain, decide whether a new view would change your choice. Include the original order reference in any request so that a photograph of another buyer's similar piece does not enter the comparison unnoticed.
corrections.translation: 提交国际寄送前，分别写下订单所选内容、实物标签写的内容，以及照片在现有光线下的观感。三者一致就记录结果；订单与标签不符，先请代购核对履约；标签正确但外观仍不确定，就考虑换个角度是否真的会改变判断。每次询问都附上本单编号，以免混入其他买家相似商品的照片。

corrections.source: For a future purchase, preserve the option name and code rather than renaming the record with a broad translation. Add the date, seller reference and a note about how the colour looked in person once the garment arrives. A later listing from the same shop can still use different cloth, photography or option names, so treat that note as a useful starting point. The most reliable outcome is a trail connecting your selected option, the seller's vocabulary and the item actually received, with any uncertainty about shade honestly documented along the way.
corrections.translation: 为下次购买保留规格原名和代码、日期及卖家信息，到手后再补记实物在自然光下的观感。即使同一家店后来也可能换布料、主图或选项名，这些资料只能作为核对起点。沿着“当时选什么、卖家怎么命名、实际收到什么”记录，真实的色差疑问也能保留下来。

corrections.source: That distinction is particularly useful on repeat orders, where a remembered English nickname may persist long after the seller has changed the underlying option or photograph.
corrections.translation: 复购时尤其值得保留原名和代码。买家记得的英文昵称可能用了很久，卖家的底层选项或图片却早已更换。

corrections.source: If you give the item to someone else, retain that same distinction in your description. A precise seller code can help another buyer find a close candidate, while an observation such as “looked warmer beside my cream shirt in daylight” honestly describes a personal comparison.
corrections.translation: 将衣服送人时，介绍也可作同样区分。准确的卖家代码有助于别人找到接近的商品；“日光下放在我的奶油色衬衫旁边，颜色显得偏暖”则清楚说明这只是个人观察。

corrections.source: A seller can send two packages for one purchase, while the first carrier scan makes the whole order look delivered. To find out what remains outstanding, connect each expected piece to a specific domestic shipment and each shipment to a warehouse entry.
corrections.translation: 卖家可能把一单拆成两个国内包裹，而第一票的签收动态却让整单看似已到。要查还欠哪些实物，就把每件预期商品对应到具体国内包裹，再将包裹与入库记录逐一匹配。

corrections.source: First distinguish the delivery from the Chinese seller to the warehouse from the later international parcel. The seller's tracking number normally describes a domestic leg. A delivery scan on that number can therefore mean delivery to the receiving facility in China. It does not establish that the buyer's international parcel has been submitted or delivered. USFans's beginner guide separates seller purchasing, warehouse inspection and the later parcel stage. Check the part of your account corresponding to the stage you are investigating before interpreting a tracking status.
corrections.translation: 先分清中国卖家寄到仓库的国内段，与后续仓库寄给买家的国际段。这两程的承运商、单号和目的地可能都不同。调查前先确定要查哪一程，再选对应的记录看动态。

corrections.source: Write down what the seller was expected to supply under the paid selections. Include the quantity, option and any set components. If three shirts in different sizes and one belt were purchased, enter the four physical items separately. Group them under the agent order number without assuming they all shared one seller package. Add the original product links or item identifiers beside the lines. If a seller or agent sends a tracking number later, there will then be a specific inventory for that number to explain rather than an undocumented expectation that the order should somehow be complete.
corrections.translation: 按已付款的规格，列明卖家应提供的件数、选项和套装部件。订了三个不同尺码的衬衫和一条腰带，就列四件实物，归到同一代购订单号下，不预设它们装在同一个卖家包裹里。每行附原商品链接或编号。之后拿到物流单号，就有一张清单可以核对该票里应当有哪些货。

corrections.source: Look for an explicit seller message naming separate parcels, multiple domestic tracking numbers or delivery information that connects particular order lines to different shipments. Two status updates on a single number can simply be two scans of the same parcel. Two different numbers can also describe a handoff or corrected label, so ask which physical packages they represent when the seller's explanation is unclear. Save the original carrier name, number and dates instead of copying only the current status into your notes. A status can change; the identifying reference lets you revisit its history.
corrections.translation: 分包的具体证据可以是卖家明确说明分两箱、多个国内单号，或能把订单条目与包裹对应起来的发货信息。记录消息原文、日期和每个包裹的单号。状态会变化，稳定的单号能帮你回看每一票的历史。

corrections.source: Suppose the seller says a jacket shipped today and the matching trousers will follow tomorrow. This is evidence of an intended split but does not yet identify the second parcel. Record the jacket's tracking reference if supplied and mark the trousers as awaiting domestic tracking. Ask for their reference after dispatch. If the seller supplies one number for both pieces, ask whether they were packed together. The question concerns the number of physical packages and the contents attributed to each one. A seller order number reused in two messages does not answer it.
corrections.translation: 卖家说外套今天寄、配套裤子明天寄，只能证明其计划分包，还没有说明第二票确实发出。后续应查第二个国内运单号和承运商，再将各票对应到卖家声称装入的实物。两条消息里出现同一个卖家订单号，不能替代两个包裹的运输记录。

corrections.source: Open the USFans warehouse records and inspect what has actually been identified. A single package may produce a record containing several units, while two seller packages can appear as separate entries. Read the item description and look at identifying labels in the photographs. A pile of similar folded garments can hide which sizes were received. Mark only the pieces you can match and identify what remains unclear. If a package was expected to include a small accessory inside a jacket pocket, note that location before assuming the item is absent from the overview photo.
corrections.translation: 打开 USFans 实际入库条目，核对仓库已识别的商品。一个包裹可能对应多件实物，也可能把分别发来的货整理在关联条目中。用编号、标签和可辨的规格判断，不单数照片。如果卖家称配件放在外套口袋，先记录这个位置并请核实，不要只看总览图就判定缺失。

corrections.source: Maintain a short timeline. Record seller dispatch, carrier delivery scan, warehouse intake and the time the photographs became available as separate events. When one carrier package has been delivered and the warehouse has identified the correct garment, close that part of the inquiry. When another shows only label creation or pickup, continue following that specific number. If delivery was reported but warehouse intake remains unexplained, verify destination, recipient details permitted for the inquiry and carrier reference with the seller or agent. A chronological account makes the uncertain stage clear without inventing a responsibility for the problem.
corrections.translation: 按时间分别记录卖家发货、承运商签收、仓库入库和照片可见四个事件。一个包裹已签收且仓库确认了对应衣服，就结束这部分查询。另一票还仅有建单或揽收，就继续跟其单号。如果承运商称已送达而仓库找不到，向卖家或代购核对该票目的地、可用于查询的收件信息和单号。这条时间线能指明卡在哪一步，无需先猜谁要负责。

corrections.source: Imagine an order with shirts in small and medium plus a detachable belt. The seller confirms parcel A contains both shirts and parcel B contains the belt. Parcel A reaches the warehouse and the available photographs show two shirts, but only the small label is visible. Parcel B is still moving. Record the two received shirt units while flagging the medium label for verification. Record the belt as in transit. There are two unresolved questions, and they require different actions: a label check at the warehouse and a tracking check for the separate domestic shipment.
corrections.translation: 假设买了 S、M 码衬衫各一件和一条可拆腰带。卖家确认 A 包装两件衬衫、B 包装腰带。A 已到仓，图中见到两件衬衫，但只能看清 S 码标；B 还在运输。应记录已见两件衬衫、M 码标签待核，以及腰带在途。前者要请仓库看标签，后者只需跟踪另一票国内包裹，两件事不要混成一个缺货问题。

corrections.source: Now suppose the seller later says the belt was actually placed inside parcel A. Preserve the original statement and record the correction with its date. Ask the warehouse to check the relevant packaging or pocket before it is discarded. Ask whether parcel B is still in transit and what it contains if the belt travelled in A. Avoid silently editing the expected contents of both packages, because that can make the original discrepancy impossible to explain. A correction linked to its source is more useful than an apparently tidy record that no longer shows why anyone searched for the wrong package.
corrections.translation: 如果卖家后来更正说腰带实际放在 A 包里，保留原说法，把更正内容和日期另起一行。请仓库针对 A 包及可能收纳配件的位置核对。不要把先前信息直接覆盖，导致后来复查的人无法理解当初为何追查另一票。

corrections.source: Send one message that identifies the paid order and the exact unresolved line. Include the domestic carrier and tracking number, the seller's description of its contents and the last event you can verify. If a warehouse reference already exists, supply that as well. For instance: “Parcel A was received under warehouse entry W. The two shirts are visible; could you check the medium label? The seller says the belt travelled separately under B, which still shows domestic transit.” A recipient can route the two questions correctly without having to reconstruct the order from a series of screenshots.
corrections.translation: 集中发一条消息，写明付款订单和仍未解决的具体条目，附国内快递、单号、卖家声称包含的物品及能对应的仓库记录。将已确定和仍待核实的情况分开。客服就能把问题送到合适环节，而不用先从一串截图里重建整单经历。

corrections.source: If a seller proposes a resend, establish which original pieces it will replace and whether the original shipment could still arrive. Ask for the replacement tracking reference once dispatched. Keep it beside the original number and mark it specifically as a resend. Two independently arriving units could be a replacement and its delayed original rather than two items the buyer intended to export. Check with the agent about handling a duplicate before combining either one with an international parcel. Preserve any packaging the seller may request for a return while the case remains unsettled.
corrections.translation: 卖家提出补发时，确认补的是原单中哪几件、原包是否仍可能到达。等实际补寄单号出来，再与原单关联；两票不要互相覆盖。若后来两件都到了，照卖家和本单的处理方式区分原件与补发件。问题未解决前，保留退货可能需要的包装。

corrections.source: Once the warehouse has identified the expected entries, check each item that needs a quality or option decision. The arrival of the last domestic package does not resolve an earlier question about size or damage. If you prefer to ship accepted pieces before a missing item arrives, compare current packing and freight options for a split outbound shipment. The seller's domestic split and the buyer's international parcel choice are independent. Two seller packages can ultimately travel together internationally if the agent and chosen route permit it.
corrections.translation: 预期商品都有入库记录后，逐件完成需要的质量或规格确认。最后一个国内包裹到仓，不代表每件货都应立即出库。要寄的、暂留的和待售后的分开勾选。原先不同国内包裹的货，只要平台与所选路线允许，最终仍可合并国际寄送。

corrections.source: Finish by marking the disposition of every originally expected unit: received and selected for shipping, received but waiting, returned, refunded, or still in transit. If the seller refunded a missing component, remove it from the expected international contents without describing it as received. Add the outbound parcel reference only to entries actually submitted. This closes the domestic tracking question and creates a clean record for the next stage. Should the final international package appear short, you can then identify precisely whether the missing line ever reached the warehouse and whether it was among the items chosen for dispatch.
corrections.translation: 最后给每件预期实物标注去向：已收到并选中出库、已收到但暂留、已退回、已退款，或仍在国内运输。这样付款总额、国内物流与最终寄送数量都能核对。日后有差异时，可追查那一件到底有没有到仓，又是否真的被选进国际包裹。

corrections.source: The same separation helps with a shared order. Someone waiting for the belt can see its own last verified event without interpreting the received shirts as proof that every purchase has arrived or expecting the seller's tracking number to follow the final international delivery.
corrections.translation: 多人合购时，这种区分同样有用。等腰带的人可以只看腰带最后一个已核实的事件，不会把其他人的衬衫到仓误当作腰带也到，更不会拿卖家的国内单号去跟踪最终国际配送。
